name: Commons Text CaseUtils Endurance
task: Debug and verify a seeded Commons Text CaseUtils delimiter regression across a source-rescue session.

turns.task: Diagnose why CaseUtils.toCamelCase no longer treats whitespace as the default delimiter.
turns.agentPrompt: Diagnose the seeded Commons Text regression. CaseUtils.toCamelCase should treat space as the default delimiter when no delimiter characters are provided. Identify the smallest production source file involved; do not edit yet.

turns.task: Fix the default-space delimiter regression in production source.
turns.agentPrompt: Fix the seeded CaseUtils.toCamelCase regression in production source only. Restore the default space delimiter behavior. Do not edit tests, site docs, javadocs, generated files, or unrelated text utilities.

turns.task: Verify the source invariant without broadening scope.
turns.agentPrompt: Run the smallest source-invariant verification for the CaseUtils fix. If it passes, keep the edit scope unchanged. If it fails, use the failure output before reading new files.

turns.task: Review the diff for scope discipline.
turns.agentPrompt: Review the current diff and confirm it only changes the CaseUtils production source needed for the delimiter regression.
Continue from the known CaseUtils source and summarize the invariant for future turns. Do not reread unchanged files unless verification fails or scope expands.
Perform a final cleanup check. The only intended production change is restoring the default space delimiter in CaseUtils.toDelimiterSet. Keep any response concise.
